# MFE Store Example

A non-trivial micro frontends example store. Three teams - explore, decide and checkout - publish
their components as custom elements, and the shell prerenders every route at build time, so the
markup behind each url below is already in the html a crawler receives.

## Pages

- [Home](/): the categories the store sells
- [Machines](/products): every category
- [Classic tractors](/products/classic)
- [Autonomous tractors](/products/autonomous)
- [Stores](/stores): the stores that stock the machines
- [Cart](/checkout/cart)
- [Checkout](/checkout/checkout)
- [Order received](/checkout/thanks)

## Product pages

Every machine has a page at `/product/:id` - for example [AU-03](/product/AU-03). The ids are the
ones `decide/database/database.json` holds, and a `?sku=` query picks one of a machine's variants.
